Reward remaining arguments retain their frozen-command equality check. The helper compares sys.argv to the canonical suffix and current.cmdline() to the canonical command before both ancestry paths. Interpreter argv0 is resolved-path compared; remaining tokens are exact. Missing-B, extra, reordered and duplicate options fail bounded fixtures. Receipt now records actual_OS_worker_command separately.

Direct recorded logical parent or one declared Windows venv launcher only. Logical PID+creation time, same entry run prefix, actual launcher executable/command, native-worker/launcher PID distinction, and parent Popen receipt constraints remain. Parent run functions and receipt validator are AST-identical to the reviewed pre-command-repair sources. No post-Popen-file admission dependency added. Native current-process executable is not incorrectly required to equal the isolated launcher executable.

require_review now reads independent_command_rereview exclusively, with unchanged PASS/WARN, empty blockers, Type-A, exact current nine-map and MD-existence conditions. Old complete FAIL remains intact and cannot substitute for the changed-source prerequisite. Mocked reader accepted valid WARN and rejected five invalid cases.

Source/raw/schedule/caller/environment guards, strict1800 resource rule, runtime/thread/device checks and model-import ordering, algorithms/scientific/numerical criteria, reward32/8/30users/35servers, visual8/30users/4servers/full30sdrain, no retry/merge and old-evidence preservation obligations unchanged.
